headline: This repository contains NO stored data artifact of any kind and never has: git log --all --diff-filter=A --name-only over 36 commits adds zero files with a .json/.csv/.parquet/.db/.ndjson/.txt extension, and data/ in the live tree holds only a zero-byte .gitkeep. Every number is one of three kinds: (a) arithmetic over constants that are in the registration and in pmexperiment/registry.py - fully recomputable and fully anchored; (b) a figure a session reported measuring over HTTP with no retained response - unanchored and irreproducible, which docs/ACCESS.md:87-89 states plainly; (c) a figure imported from an outside publication or another repository in this program.
